title.narrative: Enhancing the Community Resilience to Overcome the Impact of Climate change shocks and stresses in Kachin.

description.narrative: This concept aims to build resilience in communities, reduce vulnerability to climate change, and enhance their ability to respond effectively to disasters. It takes a comprehensive approach that integrates health improvement, climate change adaptation, and community resilience strengthening. By addressing these key areas, the project seeks to reduce vulnerability, improve development outcomes, and promote sustainable livelihoods, ultimately fostering long-term resilience in the face of environmental and socio-economic challenges. As we have received the recommendation letter for organizational registration from Kachin State Government, it is crucial to make sure that we have a local partner leading the sustainable developmental change for the marginalized community in Kachin. In Kachin State, ongoing conflict and instability have compounded environmental degradation, economic insecurity, and social vulnerability. Illegal logging, gold mining, and other resource extraction activities have led to severe deforestation and soil degradation, worsening climate conditions and making seasonal weather patterns increasingly unpredictable. Rising temperatures, prolonged droughts, and erratic rainfall have reduced agricultural productivity and water availability, causing water sources to dry up and rendering agricultural products unsuitable due to pests and disease. These challenges threaten food security and livelihoods, particularly for smallholder farmers and marginalized communities. Women and girls face heightened risks due to the collapse of law and order following the 2021 coup. With protection mechanisms such as law and justice systems no longer functional, domestic violence and rights abuses have escalated, further exacerbating social vulnerability. To address these challenges, the project will directly benefit 2,000 individuals (850 male and 1,150 female), including pregnant and lactating women (PLW), children under five (U5), persons with disabilities (PWD), elderly individuals (60+ years old), and youth. By implementing climate-resilient solutions, strengthening community capacities, and promoting inclusive approaches, the project aims to support the recovery and long-term resilience of conflict-affected communities in Kachin State.
